data.name: Valkyries
data.detailed_description:
Ateon. Gaia created this land so that she could live with her children. As time passed, an unknown evil blemished it all.
Thus, Gaia disavowed the disobedient humans and abandoned the world she created. From that day on, she was referred to as “Terra”.

Without a primary ruler to oversee her children, Ateon soon fell into chaos and the First Valkyrian War was recorded in history.
The Valkyrie were sacred creatures that would fuse themselves with warriors, imbuing the chosen ones with fantastic powers to defeat true evil.
From the ashes of war, the Kingdom of Rose was born. The tenacious people sought to unite the world under one rule. They aimed their blades at any who would go against them. Purging the world of imperfections in hopes that it will summon Terra back to their world.

Centuries later, in pursuit of absolute perfection, the Kingdom of Rose continued its conquest. Emperor Tobias Rosenthal developed a ruthless system to breed out all disobedience.

The youth were the main target. If any blemish was found on a student, they would be purged.

As more and more lands were conquered, the Way of the Rose also spread, creating a vast utopia under strict enforcement.

As we begin our story, Ascanius Rosenthal races towards school. With death used as a constant reminder, one would imagine students would take great care to arrive to their class way ahead of schedule. However, for Ascanius, his uncanny ability to survive by the narrowest of margins impedes his decision making. Especially when it comes to extra sleep.

Built by the support of Fans
Four Character Routes (July 2018)

reviews.review:
I wouldn't recommend to support this dev. https://steamcommunity.com/id/valkiriana/status/1566690417

[i] Heartomics: Valkyries [/i] is a short fantasy visual novel. Maybe some players will find it relaxing as one of its tags implies. Unfortunately, I can't say I liked it.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1758761892 
[b] Pros [/b]:
+ Nice art. Backgrounds really are pretty. There's a gallery with approximately 100 CGs.
+ Cards.
+ Good English. I've noticed just one typo (mean while).
+ MC had the same surname, Rosenthal, as one of the most outstanding linguists in my country. I still often use his textbooks. It felt nice. xD
+ No patch is necessary. You may enable/disable nudity at the beginning of the game.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1758761919 
[b] Cons [/b]:
– WEIRD SETTINGS. When I started the game I didn't see any. But they turned out to be...in the Gallery O_O
– sound and music options. It took lots of clicking to adjust them. Maybe I was doing smth in a wrong way but there was no reaction.
– text speed. Even at its max it is still too slow, even for me, ESL person. So again there was a lot of clicking—for the sentence totally to appear.
– no backlog. Or so I thought all the game long. Only when I had finished playing, I found it in 'Help' section. O_o
– text size. It is too little when it's not in the text bar. Besides, it's hard to read at colorful backgrounds. 
– no hiding text. H is not working. Maybe it's somewhere else, nothing will surprise me at this point, but I couldn't find it.
– buggy save. I couldn't save during prologue. Save works only when there's text bar and I click settings. When there's none and I use right click, I appear at settings as well, but the previous file I used for save is saved again and not where I stopped. Once I decided to rewrite the save file and the image did change. But when I tried to continue the game from that place, it started from that original save. Wtf
– I had to set 'windowed' mode every time I started the game, it'd be nice if my choice was remembered.
– skip option. Only all the text. Again maybe it's me as we say it in Russian 'with hands growing from my ass', but I couldn't set it the way I needed.
– F12 is not working. No screenshots without side programs. 
– long transitions between scenes.
– lips are moving too fast. Who are characters? Rappers? 
– no guide. The first playthrough is short. Then it just takes time to unlock all CGs. Anyway you'll need to be in the game long enough to get all cards. 
– scenes seem abrupt. Not smooth writing at all. It feels like not a story but some compilation of episodes. Nsfw pictures appear just for a second at the end of the mature description and that's all, the story proceeds leaving unsatisfied. And even those intimate scenes are described in a couple of sentences. Some sex descriptions were disgusting for me. [spoiler] with the queen, his aunt... welp, it went not too far but even what I read made me wanna puke [/spoiler]
– silly story. That's actually dev's quotation. Even when the creator thinks so...dunno even what else to add. I guess there's nothing wrong in it though. Not all games should be deep and serious...
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1758761958 
It's a crucial thing for me how well I can adjust the game for my taste. Maybe it could be a nice relaxing experience but all those issues with settings make the game unrecommendable. I even didn't finish it. Too many unlocked CGs still remain. But I had absolutely no desire to continue when I couldn't skip only the read text. Plus, I'm not into [strike] naked [/strike] pretty girls so much to spend more time on this game after I've already learned the story. So, maybe after some fixing I could change my review and recommend the game for one relaxing evening but not now, definitely not in this state.
